record_type_quote: The replication dataset contains similar observations to the original study, but from a different time period so a single analysis on all new data will be performed.

targets.authors: Chung, Kee H. and Chairat Chuwonganant
targets.title: Uncertainty, market structure, and liquidity
targets.evidence_quote: The claim selected for replication from Chung & Chuwonganant (2014) is that market liquidity decreases with VIX because higher volatility reduces market makers’ liquidity-provision capacity.
targets.outcome_quote:
In the original paper the estimated coefficient is positive (0.4644) and significant. In the replication, the estimated coefficient is negative (-0.02) and significant (p=0.025).

Thus the replication claim was unsuccessful according to the SCORE criteria.
targets.outcome_reasoning: Explicit overall verdict of unsuccessful replication; one target finding and one original paper.
